datasets.name: Jezero crater (MOLA MEGDR 128 px/deg)
datasets.statusNote: Gridded elevation product derived from measurements (interpolated between tracks/samples).

source.title: MGS MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record (topography)
source.label: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/mgs-m-mola-5-megdr-l3-v1/mgsl_300x/meg128/megt44n000hb.lbl
source.license: NASA PDS archive data: public domain in the U.S. (NASA data policy); cite Smith et al. 2003 MOLA MEGDR.

datum.description: MOLA topography = planetary radius − areoid (equipotential, mean equatorial radius 3396 km).

datasets.verticalAccuracy: MOLA ~1 m vertical vs. centre of mass (Smith et al. 2001), but 463 m grid with interpolation between tracks: landing-scale hazards (metres) are completely unresolved.

datasets.name: Mare Tranquillitatis — Apollo 11 site
datasets.statusNote: Gridded elevation product derived from measurements (interpolated between tracks/samples).

source.title: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Record (cylindrical 1024 px/deg)
source.label: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/lro/lro-l-lola-3-rdr-v1/lrolol_1xxx/data/lola_gdr/cylindrical/img/ldem_1024_00n_15n_000_030.lbl
source.license: NASA PDS archive data: public domain in the U.S. (NASA data policy); cite Smith et al. / LOLA team.

datasets.verticalAccuracy: LOLA ~1 m radial; at 1024 px/deg near the equator ground tracks are km apart, so many pixels are interpolated. Small craters/boulders are NOT resolved.

datasets.name: Shackleton rim / lunar south pole
datasets.statusNote: Gridded elevation product derived from measurements (interpolated between tracks/samples).

source.title: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Record (polar)
source.label: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/lro/lro-l-lola-3-rdr-v1/lrolol_1xxx/data/lola_gdr/polar/img/ldem_875s_20m.lbl
source.license: NASA PDS archive data: public domain in the U.S. (NASA data policy); cite Smith et al. / LOLA team.

datum.description: Height above 1737.4 km reference sphere (not a geoid/'sea level').

datasets.verticalAccuracy: LOLA ranging precision ~0.1 m, radial orbit error ~1 m (Mazarico et al. 2012). Gridded value between tracks is interpolated (GMT surface); per-pixel interpolation error not provided — treat <2 px features as unresolved.
